name: Knowledge Graph Memory MCP
shortDescription: Persistent long-term memory graph for AI assistants using entities, relationships, observations, and semantic recall.
longDescription: Provide AI models with persistent memory across multiple chat sessions. Entities, nodes, observations, and relations are stored in a local knowledge graph, allowing assistants to recall user preferences, project context, and past decisions.
author: modelcontextprotocol

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph.

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Create relational edges between entities in the graph.

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Add factual observations to existing entities.

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Read the entire knowledge graph structure.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes and entities matching query keywords.
